attack: SPECULATION-AS-FINDING — predictions labelled speculative, never finding-weight
expected: Every projection carries speculative=True, determinative=False, confidence=WEAK and a SPECULATIVE suggestion; the result carries autonomous=False + human_review_required + PREDICTION_NOTICE; NO output bears a [VERIFIED DATA]/[DETERMINISTIC ANALYSIS] tag.
actual: per-pred labelling=True; result markers=True; no finding-weight tag=True; render banner=True; predictions=1.

attack: FABRICATED FORWARD-INFERENCE — no invented future event/association/escalation
expected: Projects exactly one median interval from the observed series (2024-02-12); every citation is a real input occurrence; the lone single-occurrence counterparty is refused (not_built), not invented; no escalation/certainty language; empty evidence invents nothing.
actual: one_series=True; projected=2024-02-12 (expected 2024-02-12) ok=True; citations_all_real=True; label_grounded=True; ghost_refused=True; hedged=True; no_escalation=True; empty_invents_nothing=True.

attack: IDENTITY-BASED PREDICTION — identical evidence, identical prediction
expected: Two subjects with identical transaction evidence but different nationality/religion/ethnicity/origin yield IDENTICAL predictions; a subject whose only 'signal' is identity + one foreign txn yields NO prediction.
actual: identity-matched predictions identical=True; identity-alone produced 0 prediction(s) (expected 0) → silent=True.

attack: DETERMINISTIC-FIRST — prediction is deterministic; LLM is terminal-only
expected: Same input → identical structured prediction; neither Phase-4 module imports or calls an LLM. (Recon: app.py:5581/5593 pass the structured result straight to the pure render_* fn — the LLM never sees or alters it; narration is strictly terminal.)
actual: predict determinism=True; predictive.py LLM-free=True; advanced_intel.py LLM-free=True.
observation: Wiring verified by recon, not re-executed here: the app renders the pure dict; no narration path mutates it.

expected: autonomous=False + human_review_required=True + guilt=False + notice on every result; every suggestion hedged 'for officer consideration / not a directive / not a finding of guilt'; nodes ⊆ input subjects (no fabrication); cut-vertex ranked first; solo/empty invent nothing.
actual: markers=True; hedged=True; no_operational_directive=True; no_fabricated_nodes=True; cut_vertex_first=True; solo_invents_nothing=True; empty_ok=True.
observation: FRAMING NOTE for triage: the module/notice/header use the word 'DISMANTLING' and node rationales say 'removal would fragment its cluster'. Every item is hedged and all autonomy markers hold, but the action-oriented vocabulary ('dismantling', 'removal', '***') reads more directive-adjacent than the rest of the system — a skeptical evaluator will notice it.

expected: Identity attributes attached to links are ignored: the structural ranking (degrees, articulation points, betweenness, order) is identical with or without them.
actual: ranking identical with identity keys added=True.

attack: ESCALATION HONESTY — thin evidence degrades; confidence capped at WEAK
expected: Thin (<3), zero-interval, and undated/garbage series produce NO prediction and state the reason in not_built; confidence never exceeds WEAK; and the irregular-cadence caveat DOES fire on a 4-occurrence dispersed series (intervals [2,2,148]).

attack: ESCALATION HONESTY — dispersed 3-occurrence cadence is flagged irregular; regular is not
expected: A dispersed 3-occurrence series [2,150] fires irregular_cadence with the 'rough extrapolation' caveat; a regular 3-occurrence series [14,14] does NOT; top-level WEAK/speculative labels unchanged (over-precision repaired, certainty labels untouched).
actual: dispersed: flagged=True, caveat=True, labels_honest=True; regular: clean=True.
